sections.Profile:
Follows the cross-country journey of demolitionists Red and Ted, two "talking heads" (using FunHouse's Pin-Mation technology) in search of a good paycheck. Red is voiced by country musician Carlene Carter.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1994
- In production: no
